badge_hard_rules: circular enamel pin / metal badge, perfectly round
ONE single metallic beveled tubular rim matching the scene palette
NO second outer contour, NO white double rim, NO rectangular card frame
NO nested duplicate logos or maps inside maps
artwork fills the circle; do not artificially shrink the scene with empty margins
outside the circle: pure white or transparent background only
any text is arched along the inner rim and painted into the artwork (not a flat sticker overlay)

rim_hints.gold_wide: thick polished bright gold tubular metal rim
rim_hints.rose_romantic: thick romantic rose-gold and champagne tubular metal rim, single layer, no pink glow halo
rim_hints.olive_bronze: thick dark olive-bronze gunmetal rim matching khaki/tech gear
rim_hints.gunmetal: thick dark gunmetal rim for black backgrounds
rim_hints.silver_chrome: thick bright chrome-silver rim with clean highlights, do not muddy the metal
